title: Add backpressure controls and utilization reporting to dedicated autoscaler
author: Diego Martinez
description: Motivation: Dedicated fleets have been observed to enter degraded states under sudden traffic spikes; customers expect graceful degradation and visibility. This PR adds a backpressure token-bucket layer to the dedicated autoscaler path, exposes per-fleet utilization metrics, and emits utilization-based alerts to help SREs tune capacity. Design highlights: 1) Token-bucket per-fleet with configurable burst size and refill rate; 2) Queue depth heuristics and adaptive shedding to avoid head-of-line blocking; 3) New utilization metrics (fleet_utilization_pct, fleet_burst_remaining, fleet_queue_depth) and per-route throughput guarantees annotations; 4) Reporting pipeline to the observability service (metrics + proto + tagging by customer/region). Changes are backwards-compatible: default policy preserves current behavior unless new config fields are set. Checklist: implemented autoscaler backpressure logic; added config schema and migration docs; instrumented metrics and dashboards; added unit and integration tests; staged rollout config and canary gating. Related work: builds on ENG-4872 and follows follow-ups from pr-2234501 and pr-2234502. Rollout plan: feature-gate off by default; enable on canary tenants for 48h; monitor fleet_utilization_pct and latency SLOs; then wider rollout with gradual enablement and automated rollback if error budget burn observed.

review_comments: Aisha Kapoor: Overall looks good. Question: how do we ensure fairness across tenants sharing a pool? Would prefer a per-tenant sub-bucket or priority weights.
Diego Martinez (author): Good point. We added per-route weights and an optional per-tenant bucket in config; default remains per-fleet to avoid explosion of state. Added tests for weighted draining.

Lukas Zimmer: CI flake on initial run (integration test timeout). After bumping the test timeout and isolating test fixture startup order, CI passed. Also requested clearer dashboard thresholds for on-call.
Priya Singh: Please add migration notes for existing dedicated configs; confirmed added to docs/ops/dedicated-autoscaler-backpressure.md
testing: Unit tests added for token bucket edge cases and queue heuristics; integration test simulates 10x traffic spike and validates shedding behavior; manual canary exercised on two internal dedicated tenants for 48h with no SLO regressions observed.
slo_impact: Expected to reduce P95 latency tail during sustained spikes by limiting queueing and prioritizing guaranteed throughput. No change to existing SLOs required; rollout will be monitored and thresholds can be tuned via feature flags.
observability_changes: Added Grafana dashboard 'Dedicated Fleet Utilization' with panels for utilization, burst remaining, queue depth, and shed events. Added alert: FleetUtilizationHigh when fleet_utilization_pct > 85% for 5m.
rollback_plan: Feature flagged; immediate rollout can be disabled via deploy/feature_flags.yaml. If increased error budget or latency regressions observed, flip gate and revert via automated rollback script. Critical hotfix path outlined in docs/ops/dedicated-autoscaler-backpressure.md.
release_notes: Introduce configurable backpressure token-bucket for dedicated autoscaler; adds fleet utilization metrics and dashboards; feature is off by default and can be enabled per-fleet.
follow_ups: ENG-5010: Add per-tenant budgeting controls in shared pools
SRE-210: Tune default burst/refill values based on workload classes
notes: This PR consolidates prior backpressure experiments and standardizes metrics naming for downstream billing and capacity planning. Config defaults are conservative to avoid customer-visible regressions.
